description: Adds phrase translation button to option group title and description
find:
<xf:textboxrow name="title" value="{$group}"
				label="{{ phrase('title') }}" />

			<xf:textarearow name="description" value="{$group}"
				autosize="true"
				label="{{ phrase('description') }}"
				hint="{{ phrase('you_may_use_html') }}" />
replace:
<xf:textboxrow name="title" value="{$group}"
				label="{{ phrase('title') }}"
				phrase="{{ $group.isUpdate() ? 'option_group.' . $group.group_id : '' }}" />

			<xf:textarearow name="description" value="{$group}"
				autosize="true"
				label="{{ phrase('description') }}"
				hint="{{ phrase('you_may_use_html') }}"
				phrase="{{ $group.isUpdate() ? 'option_group_description.' . $group.group_id : '' }}" />
